name: Newsletter Studio
oneLiner: Tailored intelligence briefs: tell Lia what you follow in one conversation, get your brief by email or Slack.
problem: I had automated my own fintech brief, and everyone I showed it to wanted one for their field. The hard part wasn't the automation, it was letting someone who has never seen a workflow describe their world in a sentence and get a system built for them.
built: A conversational onboarding: Lia interviews you, finds candidate sources, checks that each one is alive and fresh, and curates your set.
One shared engine for every user, so an improvement ships to everyone at once.
Bring your own key: each user plugs in their own AI key, which keeps it free to host and let me open source it.
Guardrails from day one: an abuse detector, captcha, and briefs that can only go to the account's own address.
proof: First beta: 12 sign-ups, 3 launched a brief. Activation, not capability, was the problem, and it shaped the next version.
Runs my own fintech newsletter, twice a week.
